activation_policy.rule: A divergence may not activate, produce a test skip, or excuse a deleted test until its exact upstream conformance test IDs are ratified at the applicable wave gate.

growth_policy.rule: The five ADR-0638 W0 baseline seed rows establish the initial ledger and do not consume a wave growth budget. After that baseline, adding more than two new divergence rows in one wave is rejected.
growth_policy.c_prime_rule: Exactly one ADR-authorized C-prime client transition row may be added outside the per-wave growth budget when G2 fires; it must cite the one-time transition receipt and no second exemption exists.

conformance_expected_red.ratification_requirement: W0-B and W2 must enumerate and ratify exact upstream conformance IDs before Cedar authorization behavior can activate.

expiry.condition: Expires when a ratified bit-compatible upstream authorization replacement removes this seam, or when an accepted ADR renews it.

rows.rationale: The doctrine-first program decision keeps Cedar as the authorization seam while requiring an RBAC-equivalence proof obligation and advance enumeration of any expected-red conformance cases.
rows.review_cadence: every wave gate and before W2 activation
rows.conformance_impact: Authorization behavior may produce expected-red upstream RBAC conformance cases; exact IDs and the RBAC-equivalence obligation remain pending enumeration.

conformance_expected_red.ratification_requirement: W0-B and W2 must enumerate and ratify exact upstream conformance IDs before owned audit-chain behavior can activate.

expiry.condition: Expires when the owned audit-chain emission is proven bit-compatible with the upstream behavior it replaces, or when an accepted ADR renews it.

rows.rationale: The port emits through the owned audit chain rather than introducing an ungoverned parallel audit path; any observable divergence remains an expected-red exception only after ID ratification.
rows.review_cadence: every wave gate and before W2 activation
rows.conformance_impact: Audit event transport or schema may differ from upstream; exact affected conformance IDs remain pending enumeration.

conformance_expected_red.ratification_requirement: W0-B and W2 must enumerate and ratify exact upstream conformance IDs before owned observability behavior can activate.

expiry.condition: Expires when owned observability emission meets the applicable upstream parity obligation without divergence, or when an accepted ADR renews it.

rows.rationale: The port uses owned observability emission, with metrics, audit schema, and propagation differences governed as explicit conformance-impacting exceptions rather than silent skips.
rows.review_cadence: every wave gate and before W2 activation
rows.conformance_impact: Metrics, labels, traces, or operator-load-bearing logs may differ from upstream; exact affected conformance IDs remain pending enumeration.

conformance_expected_red.ratification_requirement: W0-B and W2 must enumerate and ratify exact upstream conformance IDs before the provider or volume-plugin removals can activate.

expiry.condition: Expires when no removed in-tree provider or volume-plugin behavior remains in the admitted upstream corpus, or when an accepted ADR renews it.

rows.rationale: In-tree legacy cloud providers and in-tree volume plugins are removed from scope; CSI drivers and other approved external runtimes are consumed rather than ported.
rows.review_cadence: every wave gate and before W2 activation
rows.conformance_impact: Tests requiring removed in-tree provider or volume-plugin behavior may be expected-red only after exact ID ratification.

conformance_expected_red.ratification_requirement: W0-B must enumerate the exact conformance impact, if any, and W2 must ratify exact upstream conformance IDs before the bootstrap dependency can support activation.

expiry.condition: Expires only after the owned Rust front end passes the full-corpus model-equivalence gate for one complete absorption cycle and the bootstrap extractor is retired.
expiry.latest_review_gate: every wave gate through owned-front-end retirement

rows.rationale: The out-of-band Go extractor is a temporary dependency that produces a signed, content-addressed SourceModel snapshot; it is excluded from verify() and must be replaced by a model-equivalent owned Rust front end.
rows.review_cadence: every wave gate and before every front-end replacement increment
rows.conformance_impact: No behavior difference is authorized by the bootstrap dependency; any observed conformance impact remains a defect until exact IDs are enumerated and ratified.
